title: The Vienna Schools of Psychotherapy Gold Coin Set Proof
descriptionPlain: Sigmund Freud, Alfred Adler and Viktor Frankl were the founders of the three different Vienna schools of psychotherapy, the scientific discipline established in the Austrian capital in the 20th century. Freud (1856–1939) was the father of psychoanalysis, Adler (1870–1937) founded individual psychology, while Frankl (1905–1997) was the founder of logo therapy, the three pioneering schools of psychotherapy to which this fascinating three-coin series is dedicated. The men behind them feature on the obverse of each coin, while the reverse illustrates the core concept of their respective theories. This set features all three gold coins stored in the matching collector case. Collect insights into the essence of the human mind with the help of The Vienna Schools of Psychotherapy series.
